b6_reason: A non-specific defence present at birth describes innate immunity; acquired immunity is pathogen-specific and develops after exposure, so this statement is incorrect.
b6_note: Source damage in option 3: the text is scrambled as "mory of first encounterAnamnestic response is due to me ." (intended: "Anamnestic response is due to memory of first encounter"). It is a correct statement either way, so it does not affect the choice, but option 3 needs re-extraction.
